title: Nutraceutical Franchise Opportunity
name: Omega 3 Zone, 2 Franchisees, Est'd in 2017, Paphos HQ
description: Omega 3 Zone is a German premium omega-3 supplement brand with almost ten years in the market, 24 certificates and industry awards, and the number two position among omega-3 brands online in Germany. The product is manufactured by Omega3Zone GmbH in Nuremberg, founded 2017; brand and technology rights are held by Omega3zone Global LTD in Paphos, Cyprus. The group operates from two countries and sells online into 29. We license the branded concentrate rather than only selling finished product - the Coca-Cola model. Partners buy the concentrate from us and sell either under the Omega 3 Zone name or under their own label. The concentration technology is protected in 181 countries and delivers 5,400 units of omega-3 per dose against roughly 1,500 in a standard supplement. Existing B2B buyers include supermarket chains, drugstore chains, gyms, salons, and spas. No retail premises are required: the model runs on B2B distribution and online sales. There are no royalties in any partner format. The brand operates with a valid business license.
